text:
elaine: quick UX thread 1: bulk-approve modal copy + a11y checks for eval runs. pushed copy variants in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789/bulk-approve-modal
vik: saw it. Variant A is shorter: "Approve selected results?" Variant B has a safety line: "Approving will mark selected results as accepted and close the review." which seems clearer for unfamiliar users.
tom: prefer B for clarity. also add an inline counter ("3 results selected") so people know scope.
marco: a11y: modal should set focus to the primary action on open and restore focus after close. keyboard users expect that. also trap focus.
elainE: small nit: analytics event should be `eval.bulk_approve.confirm` with properties: `count`, `user_tier`, `prompt_set_id`.
aria-bot: accessibility-scan: contrast ok, but close icon lacks accessible name. recommend `aria-label="Close dialog"`.
vik: voiceover note: when modal opens announce: "Confirm bulk approve, 3 results selected. Approve changes or cancel." use `aria-live=polite` + `role=dialog`.
tom: copy tweak: primary CTA text variants: "Approve changes" vs "Approve selected". which is clearer? Btw analytics wants the verb "Approve".
marco: for screen readers "Approve selected results" is explicit. visually shorter labels ok, but keep long `aria-label` on the button.
elaine: UX tradeoff: longer text increases button width and might wrap on mobile. proposal: show short label visually and set `aria-label` to longer copy.
vik: confirm mobile behavior: modal full-screen on < 420px and ensure bottom safe area padding. touch targets 44px min.
aria-bot: keyboard-scan: forwarded a11y checklist: trap focus, focus visible indicator, dialog role, labelledby pointing to heading, close button accessible, confirm button has descriptive aria-label.
tom: micro-copy for cancel: "CancelKeep review open"? feels verbose. Maybe just "Cancel" with secondary hint line under heading.
elaine: mockup updated: heading "Approve selected results"; hint text: "This action cannot be undone for these results." CTA: visual: "Approve" (aria-label: "Approve selected results").
marco: implement note: avoid re-rendering entire eval list on confirm. optimistic update + background reconcile. show `toast` with undo for 5s.
vik: screen reader undo: announce "3 results approved. Undo available for 5 seconds." via `aria-live` region.
tom: unit tests: keyboard focus trap + restore; screen reader announcement mock; analytics event fired with correct props.
elaine: i'll push a PR with the updated copy + aria changes and include a short E2E a11y test using Playwright + VoiceOver emulation. tagging @tom @vik for review.
aria-bot: accessibility-scan: run scheduled on branch — next report due after PR opened.
